3240b1d5bfafe1a1352293b26244136dd17e3201: La Joue du Loup offers 100 km of well-marked runs, a mid-sized ski area that is ideal for spending 4 to 5 days without ever doing exactly the same thing twice. La Joue du Loup's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, a well-run childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Southern Alps for teaching children the basics of skiing. The altitude of La Joue du Loup (1450 m at the base, 2464 m at the top) helps it maintain decent snow cover through the depths of winter. At 44€ for a day lift pass, La Joue du Loup sits in the mid-range bracket for budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant.
